title: Unstuck
body:
Unstuck plugin is a very simple plugin to use and implement

If the player is stuck or in a difficult position and cannot move, player can use the **/unstuck** command to teleport **3 random blocks** around player to a safe place and get out of the situation.

There is a **50 seconds cooldown** to prevent abuse of the command.

If the player moves after using the command, teleportation is **canceled**.

player teleports to the Safe area within **5 seconds** after using the command.

Thats all!
